conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the S.A.S. legal form. A simplified joint-stock form.

profileFields.label: Número de inscripción
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Capital social
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the S.A.S. name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Dirección General de Registros and follows Uruguay's naming rules.

setupSteps.title: Prepare the S.A.S. documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs. Companies are entered in the Registro Nacional de Comercio, which is part of the Dirección General de Registros.

setupSteps.title: Register the S.A.S.
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Dirección General de Registros requires. The company exists once the register enters it.

setupSteps.title: Register the S.A.S. for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Dirección General Impositiva for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Banco de Previsión Social for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Dirección General de Registros, then file it and keep the company record current.

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Dirección General de Registros, the deadline and whether an audit is required.

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Dirección General Impositiva, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Dirección General Impositiva and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Banco de Previsión Social. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Dirección General de Registros.

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Dirección General de Registros, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
